issues.description: In solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java the fields are declared in snake_case (lecture_name, number_of_inscribed_students, number_of_guest_students, number_of_lecturers, number_of_tutors), but the constructor and all methods reference camelCase fields (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) that are not declared. This causes the solution code to not compile and contradicts the problem statement/UML, which specifies the camelCase attribute names.
issues.suggestedFix: Make field names consistent with the UML/spec and method usage by renaming the solution's private fields to camelCase (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). Alternatively, change every field reference in the constructor/getters/setters/toString and other methods to use the existing snake_case field names consistently.
